notices: All travelers MUST fill the Health Declaration Form. It MUST be filled not more than 72 hours before the intended date of travel.
A parent, guardian, family member, or travel agent may use the same contact for more than one traveller.

In accordance with international travel protocols, all travelers must complete a Health Declaration Form upon entry/exit. This measure supports border management, safeguards public health, and facilitates the monitoring of traveler movements for security and epidemiological purposes.
